description: Example uvm registry of open-source MATLAB libraries on GitHub. uvm reads url, branch and paths; every other field is documentation.

export_fig.description: Publication-quality figure export to PDF, EPS, PNG and more, with cropping and anti-aliasing.

fastvis.description: Fast OpenGL viewer for 2D/3D point clouds, meshes, lines, surfaces, images and text (fvFigure, fvPointcloud, fvMesh, ...).

matogl.description: Direct access to the OpenGL pipeline from MATLAB through its bundled JOGL; no MEX or compiler needed.

violinplot.description: Violin plots with kernel density, box plots and individual data points.

matlab2tikz.description: Convert figures to TikZ/PGFPlots for LaTeX.

shadederrorbar.description: Line plots with a shaded error band.

chebfun.description: Numerical computing with functions: rootfinding, integration, ODEs and PDEs to machine precision.

spot.description: Linear operators that behave like matrices (FFT, wavelets, convolution) for large-scale numerical methods.

spatialmath.description: Rotations, poses, quaternions and twists in 2D and 3D.

optimtraj.description: Trajectory optimization with direct collocation, multiple shooting and orthogonal collocation.

yalmip.description: Modeling language for optimization problems; needs a solver for most problem classes.

jsonlab.description: Fast JSON, binary JSON (BJData/UBJSON) and MessagePack encoding and decoding.

yaml.description: Read and write YAML files (yaml.load, yaml.dump).

progressbar.description: Text progress bar for loops and parfor, with time estimates.
